summary: Albuquerque Public Schools (APS) argues that the E‑Rate program should remain active, preserve technology‑neutral competition and special construction options, and that Category Two funding must reflect real network costs. Albuquerque Public Schools (APS) argues for continued Category Two support based on real network costs, permanent cybersecurity funding, fair competition rules, reasonable contract cures, and sensible consultant oversight.
